metadata.title: tokitai-filekv 存储引擎优化规划
metadata.author: P11 Performance Review Team
metadata.round_42_note: Round 42: CROSS-005 完成 — flush_memtable 去重。提取 flush_entries_to_writer() 共享函数 (~170 行)，同步 flush (原 ~350 行) 和异步 flush (原 ~280 行) 均调用同一内部实现。代码减少 ~200 行重复。634/635 tests pass (prop_delete_persistence 为预已知 flaky test), 0 clippy warnings。

phase_cross_crate_tasks.symptom: Mutex on min_key/max_key blocks concurrent reads
phase_cross_crate_tasks.root_cause: segment.rs: min_key and max_key use Mutex, requiring exclusive access even for reads
phase_cross_crate_tasks.action: Convert Mutex to RwLock. Done: read_engine.rs uses .read(), segment.rs uses .write().

phase_cross_crate_tasks.root_cause: get_used_bytes() and get_entry_count() use .unwrap() on subtraction that could underflow

phase_cross_crate_tasks.symptom: delete_by_prefix() collects all keys into memory (O(n) allocation)
phase_cross_crate_tasks.root_cause: Deletes are batched in one pass, loading all matching keys into a Vec before processing
phase_cross_crate_tasks.action: Implement streaming batched deletion with resume capability. Done: BATCH_SIZE=256, resumes from last deleted key.

phase_cross_crate_tasks.root_cause: global_index.rs:144-163. Five RwLock fields. get() acquires 2 read locks simultaneously.
phase_cross_crate_tasks.action: Consolidate into single RwLock<GlobalKeyIndexInner>. Done: index + range_index + range_index_memory_usage merged.

phase_cross_crate_tasks.symptom: Sync flush and async flush are ~300 lines of near-duplicate code
phase_cross_crate_tasks.root_cause: Both paths implement identical: entry loop, block finalization, zone map tracking, segment creation, state update.
phase_cross_crate_tasks.action: Extract flush_entries_to_writer() shared function (~170 lines). Sync and async become thin wrappers calling the same internal implementation.

phase_cross_crate_tasks.symptom: ~25 dead_code items, unused metrics tracking, stale comments
phase_cross_crate_tasks.root_cause: code quality scan found dead methods in bloom/, compaction/, query/, ops/ modules.
phase_cross_crate_tasks.action: Remove all confirmed dead code. Keep only feature flag stubs and test-only items.

phase_cross_crate_tasks.symptom: Level-aware segment grouping duplicated in get() and get_batch()
phase_cross_crate_tasks.root_cause: read_engine.rs:310-318 and :511-519 both build l0_ids/l1_ids/l2_ids/l3_ids. ZoneMap min/max pruning also duplicated 4 ways.
phase_cross_crate_tasks.action: Extract segment_contains_key() and group_segments_by_level() helpers. Done: eliminated 2x and 4x duplication.

phase_cross_crate_tasks.root_cause: No focused benchmarks for GlobalKeyIndex ops, WAL channel throughput, write coalescer, merge iterator, L2 cache, sequential prefetcher.
phase_cross_crate_tasks.action: Add focused benchmarks for identified gaps.
